recommendations.rationale: The library already uses a property-based pattern for label overrides (e.g., labelCopy, labelCopied, labelRowsPerPage, closeLabel on hx-toast). Extending this pattern consistently across all 15 affected components is the lowest-friction path: no new framework dependency, Drupal Twig integration is trivial via attributes, and it preserves the existing API shape. A secondary recommendation is to adopt Intl.PluralRules for components with count-dependent strings (hx-rating stars).

phase1.description: Critical path: Add missing label properties to the 5 highest-impact components used in every healthcare application. These components have the most hardcoded strings or appear in every page layout.
changes: hx-color-picker: Add 8 label properties (labelGradient, labelHue, labelOpacity, labelSwatches, labelSwitchFormat, labelColorValue, labelPicker, labelTrigger function)
hx-pagination: Add labelFirstPage, labelPrevPage, labelNextPage, labelLastPage, labelPageOf function
hx-data-table: Add labelSelectAll, labelSortBy function, labelSelectRow function
hx-date-picker: Add labelChooseDate, labelPrevMonth, labelNextMonth, labelOpenCalendar, labelCloseCalendar
hx-alert: Add severityLabels partial-override map, add closeLabel property

phase2.description: Secondary: Address navigation components, overlays, and complex composites. These appear frequently in app shells and must be localizable for any international deployment.
changes: hx-split-panel: Add labelResize, labelCollapseStart, labelCollapseEnd, labelExpand function
hx-rating: Add labelStar function, labelValueText function

phase3.description: RTL layout support: Migrate all physical CSS properties (margin-left, padding-right, left:, right:) to logical CSS equivalents across all 9 affected components. Also addresses remaining minor string issues in hx-carousel, hx-combobox, hx-file-upload, hx-stat, hx-tree-view, hx-time-picker, hx-avatar.
